zabal:sub:v1:15.answer:
A dashboard that reads an artist's Respect (Optimism), Empire Builder rank (Base), and WaveWarZ battle record (Solana) and shows it all in one place.  We combine three separate ecosystems that don't talk to each other anywhere else. WaveWarZ's dashboard only knows about WaveWarZ. It has no idea what your Respect balance is (that's Optimism) or your Empire Builder rank. Nobody today can see "this artist's full standing across everything ZAO" in one place — not even ZAO's own team, as far as the public docs show.
A WaveWarZ profile page is a live webpage WaveWarZ controls. If it goes down, changes its numbers, or the artist wants to prove their standing to someone who's never heard of WaveWarZ (a festival booker, a label, a sponsor), that person has to trust a website they don't know. An EAS attestation is a permanent, independently-verifiable record on a public blockchain — it exists whether or not wavewarz.info is online in six months, and anyone can check it against zero platform. Sign in with Farcaster or connect a wallet directly. Mint a permanent, verifiable EAS attestation of your standing on Base - something to show a festival, sponsor, or label without needing them to trust a screenshot. Bridges an artist's Base and Solana wallets automatically via their Farcaster verified addresses, so one person's full ZAO footprint shows up in one view.

I created a song about ZABAL Gamez using Suno and Ableton. I wrote the lyrics, recorded my vocals into Suno, shaped the final sound in Ableton, and brought the vision to life.

Then I took the finished track to ChatGPT and Grok, where I turned the song into a complete cinematic music video. Using storytelling through AI-generated visuals, every step pushed the creative process further.

That was the moment I realized I'm not replacing creativity with AI, I'm amplifying it. I'm a hybrid artist, using technology to turn ideas into experiences.
